mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 225Ac-PSMA-62 is an investigational actinium-225-labeled small-molecule ligand that binds prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA) on prostate cancer cells and delivers alpha-particle radiation to PSMA-expressing tumor sites.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Targeted binding to PSMA followed by internalization and localized alpha-radiation-induced DNA damage and cell death.
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Tumor targeting is based on PSMA expression; physiologic uptake is also expected in normal PSMA-expressing tissues such as salivary glands and kidneys.

typical_use.histology: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (reported investigational context)
clinical_settings: Investigational therapy for advanced PSMA-positive prostate cancer
typical_use.scope: Not approved; reported in early clinical/investigational radioligand therapy context.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: PSMA-targeted radioligands can accumulate in salivary glands, exposing glandular tissue to alpha radiation.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-associated for PSMA radioligand therapy; agent-specific quantitative characterization not established here.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Systemic radiation exposure from targeted alpha therapy may affect bone marrow, particularly in heavily pretreated patients with extensive bone metastases.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-associated for radioligand therapy; agent-specific quantitative characterization not established here.

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Renal handling and physiologic uptake of PSMA-targeted radioligands may expose kidneys to radiation.
adverse_effects.mechanism_status: Class-associated for PSMA radioligand therapy; agent-specific quantitative characterization not established here.

other_reported_adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Reported commonly across PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy literature, but not confirmed here with agent-specific incidence for 225Ac-PSMA-62.
